shared_elements: schematic carved symbols or glyph-like forms
justification: The clearest shared content is the use of schematic, rounded, glyph-like motifs including circles/ovals and occasional face-like forms. The major difference is that A is organized as a single frontal anthropomorphic figure with body features and large internal markings, while B is a dense grid of many separate signs with no comparable whole figure or bodily scheme.
